cohort: 120 patients with a previous caesarean section and gestational age >37 weeks treated at Khyber Teaching Hospital, Peshawar, Pakistan from December 2017 to December 2019.
finding: Patients with short inter-delivery intervals (<18 months) had higher rates of Cesarean section and uterine scar dehiscence.
mod_finding: 5/21 (23.8%) patients with an inter-delivery interval <18 months who underwent TOLAC had a vaginal delivery, while 38/51 (74.5%) of those with an inter-delivery interval of 18-24 months who underwent TOLAC had a vaginal delivery.
